answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and, per epoch, evaluates a committed polynomial whose rate-limiting nullifier binds one message to one secret share. A duplicate attempt produces an RLN proof with two evaluations at the same identity point; combining the resulting Shamir shares reconstructs the private key, triggering immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. Semaphore trees authenticate membership, while willow, meadow, and dune label independent epochs.
